sed_contract.addresses: None, one positive line number, $, /BRE/ or two addresses separated comma; second regex searches from first matching line, numeric end before start yields start line. Optional ! negates range.

commands.d: delete current pattern space and start next cycle
commands.i: insert literal text before current record
commands.c: replace addressed range with literal text once
commands.s: s<delimiter>BRE<delimiter>replacement<delimiter>[g|p|positive match ordinal]; & whole match, \1..\9 captures, escaped delimiter literal

sed_contract.multi_script: Semicolon/LF separates commands outside quoted text, regex and escaped delimiter; repeated -e concatenate in order; braces group addressed commands. Empty script copies records.
sed_contract.in_place: -i consumes a separate empty suffix only if empty; otherwise next argument is script. Attached nonempty suffix rejects. No backups. Multiple files prepare/publish independently, stop on first failure.
